comment: What the ad_blocking check expects. 'blocked' are real ad and tracker URLs that EasyList or EasyPrivacy block (checked against the lists pinned in third_party/filter_lists/filter_lists.lock.json when this was written; tests/test_bench_ad_blocking.py checks that they match the page). 'allowed' are first-party paths on the fixture server, which must load with status 200. Keep to long-lived rules: big ad and analytics hosts.

redirects.comment: First-party URLs that redirect. 'blocked': the hop to 'target' (a listed tracker URL) must be blocked, the first URL must answer 302 and the target must never reach the network stack. 'allowed': the redirect to 'final' (first party) must be followed and load with status 200.
